subject: world_language
concept: Combining greetings, self-introduction, and polite words into one short simple exchange
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A1 'simple interaction' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays a full short greeting exchange with the persona from start to finish
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences exchange-phrase cards into the correct conversational order
exercise.abstract: Student performs a short spoken or written exchange combining all skills from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: exchange includes a greeting, self-introduction, and at least one polite word, in coherent order
misconception_flags: combines the phrases but in an order that wouldn't make sense in a real conversation

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
